grade5-7: Describe Norwegian geography: regions, settlement, industry, climate
Explain Norwegian political institutions: Stortinget, Regjering, Kommuner
Explore key events in Norwegian history: Viking Age, union with Denmark and Sweden, 1814, WWII
Discuss human rights and global inequality
grade8-10: Analyse causes and consequences of historical events (Industrial Revolution, world wars, decolonisation)
Explain how Norwegian democracy works and compare to other systems
Discuss economic systems: market economy, welfare state, globalisation
Explore identity, diversity and discrimination in Norwegian society
Analyse current events and global challenges (climate, conflict, migration)
